info.name: E-Invoice Platform — ERP Integration Contract (Sprint 1)
info.description:
Production-ready API contract for the ERP Ingestion Gateway.

COVERS:
  - ETA B2B Invoice   → POST /api/integration/v1/eta/invoices      (environment: PREPROD)
  - ETA B2C Receipt   → POST /api/integration/v1/eta/receipts      (environment: PREPROD)
  - ZATCA Standard    → POST /api/integration/v1/zatca/standard    (environment: SANDBOX)
  - ZATCA Simplified  → POST /api/integration/v1/zatca/simplified  (environment: SANDBOX)

SETUP:
  1. Run: docker compose -f docker-compose.client.yml up -d
  2. Fill in the COLLECTION VARIABLES (gear icon → Edit → Variables):
       - superuser_email / superuser_password  (from your .env)
       - eta_company_id / zatca_company_id     (UUIDs from the platform DB)
  3. Run 'Login — ETA (PREPROD)' → token auto-saved to eta_jwt_token
  4. Run 'Login — ZATCA (SANDBOX)' → token auto-saved to zatca_jwt_token
  5. All ingestion requests are ready to fire.

FIELD NAMING: All JSON keys are camelCase. snake_case variants will fail validation.
SWAGGER UI:   http://localhost:8080/swagger-ui/index.html

variable.description: Base URL of the running platform. Change port if APP_PORT differs in .env.
UUID of the ETA-registered company in the platform DB. Ask your platform admin or query: SELECT id FROM companies WHERE registration_number = '204567890';
UUID of the ZATCA-registered company in the platform DB. Ask your platform admin or query: SELECT id FROM companies WHERE registration_number = '1010345678';
Auto-populated by the 'Login — ETA (PREPROD)' request. Do not edit manually.
Auto-populated by the 'Login — ZATCA (SANDBOX)' request. Do not edit manually.

item.name: 01 — Authentication
item.description:
Obtain authority-scoped JWTs. ETA and ZATCA require separate tokens because each token is bound to a specific authority + environment combination.

Run BOTH login requests before firing any ingestion requests.

exec: console.log("ETA JWT saved. Expires in:", json.expiresInSeconds, "seconds. Mode:", json.mode);

request.description:
Authenticates against the ETA PREPROD scope. The returned accessToken is automatically saved to the 'eta_jwt_token' collection variable and used by all ETA ingestion requests.

NOTE: companyId (UUID) may be optional if your account is linked to a single company. Leave blank or set the UUID from your platform admin.

exec: console.log("ZATCA JWT saved. Expires in:", json.expiresInSeconds, "seconds. Mode:", json.mode);

request.description: Authenticates against the ZATCA SANDBOX scope. The returned accessToken is automatically saved to the 'zatca_jwt_token' collection variable and used by all ZATCA ingestion requests.

request.description:
Ingests an ETA B2B invoice (SDK v1.0 shape) that was submitted externally by the ERP.

KEY RULES:
- environment must be "PREPROD" (not SANDBOX)
- documentType "C" or "D" (credit/debit note) requires originalInvoiceNumber
- taxType T1 = VAT (subType V009 = 14%), T4 = WHT (subType W004 = 5%)
- WHT amounts are declared positive; cash deduction is handled at accounting level
- Math: totalAmount = netAmount + sum(all taxableItems.amount across all lines)

response.name: 404 Not Found — Wrong environment for authority

exec: throw new Error("eta_jwt_token is empty. Run 'Login — ETA (PREPROD)' first.");

request.description:
Ingests an ETA B2C POS receipt (SDK v1.2 shape).

KEY RULES:
- header.uuid must be exactly 64 lowercase hex characters
- Anonymous buyer: send {"type": "P", "id": null, "name": null} — do NOT send null for the whole buyer object
- seller.deviceSerialNumber = POS terminal serial (printed on the physical device)
- paymentMethod: "K" = Card, "C" = Cash
- receiptType: "r" = standard receipt, "rr" = return, "cr" = credit receipt

request.description:
Ingests a ZATCA Standard (B2B) invoice cleared by ZATCA — UBL Fatoora v2.0.3 shape.

KEY RULES:
- environment must be "SANDBOX" (not PREPROD)
- buyer is REQUIRED for Standard invoices (UBL BR-KSA-EN16931-04)
- vatNumber: exactly 15 digits starting with 3 (regex: 3[0-9]{14})
- transactionTypeCode bit-1 = 1 enforces Standard. Basic B2B = "10000000"
- vatCategoryCode "E" or "O" requires exemptionReasonCode + exemptionReasonText
- Sprint 1: currency must be "SAR" only
- clearanceStatus: populate with ZATCA API response string after clearance; null for DRAFT

exec: throw new Error("zatca_jwt_token is empty. Run 'Login — ZATCA (SANDBOX)' first.");

request.description:
Ingests a ZATCA Simplified (B2C) invoice reported to ZATCA — anonymous retail scenario.

KEY RULES:
- environment must be "SANDBOX" (not PREPROD)
- buyer: null is correct for anonymous B2C — do NOT send {} (empty object fails validation)
- transactionTypeCode bit-1 = 0 enforces Simplified. Basic B2C = "00000000"
- reportingStatus: raw ZATCA API response string (separate from top-level status enum)
- invoiceCounterValue: sequential integer per device — ERP must maintain and increment this
- paymentMeansCode: "10" = Cash, "48" = Bank Card, "42" = Bank Transfer
- Sprint 1: currency must be "SAR" only
